Allowing 0 ∈ A changes counts by O(1) at most, which is irrelevant here. The statement asserts h(n) ≠ O(√n), backed by a linked Lean proof; the page does not record this. It is consistent with the page's bounds n^{1/2} ≪ h(n) ≤ e^{O(√log n)}n^{1/2}. The formalisation of the question is correct; the status rests on the linked proof.
